text:
Asha (CSM): Quick 15m intake standup to align on VegaWell onboarding — success criteria, owners, and timeline. Proposed Tue 10:00 PT. Agenda: 1) success criteria 2) integration checklist 3) 30d milestones. Ping @Priya for PO availability.
Priya (VegaWell PO): Tue 10:00 PT works for me. Can we add a short item on data retention & masking? Important for compliance.
Liam (Solutions Eng): noted. For integration, we'll need sandbox API keys and a small sample CSV. Can someone confirm who on VegaWell will share the sample?
Priya (VegaWell PO): I'll have our infra lead share a sanitized sample by EOD Monday.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Great — once we have the sample I can spin up a staging ingest and share curl examples. Quick snippet I use for auth:```bash
export RW_API_KEY=sk-live-xxx
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Dmitri (Enablement): I can run a 30-min orientation/demo after the standup (recording + short playbook). Prefer Wed morning, but flexible.
Asha (CSM): Perfect — plan for Tue 10:00 PT standup (15m) + follow-up orientation Wed 09:30 PT (30m). I'll create the calendar invite. Quick success criteria to confirm before standup:
```
- Integration: successful staging ingest + sample inference (within 5 business days)
- Latency: median <= 250ms for typical requests in staging
- Reliability: smoke tests pass on every deploy in staging
- Enablement: 1 recorded demo + runbook delivered to VegaWell team
- Business: VegaWell can validate two core flows end-to-end in 30d
```
Priya (VegaWell PO): Those look good. Small ask: can we add data-masking validation to the runbook?
Asha (CSM): Absolutely — adding data-masking checks to the runbook. @Dmitri can you cover that in the demo?
Dmitri (Enablement): Yup — will include a 5-min segment on masking & KMS setup.
OnboardingBot: Calendar event created: "VegaWell — 15m intake standup" Tue 10:00 PT. Invitees: Asha, Priya, Liam, Dmitri.
Asha (CSM): Thanks all — I'll drop the invite and post a short pre-standup checklist in the channel 1 hour before. :thumbsup:
